prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1033; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's Narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Baytown, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a side impact at the intersection. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the traffic signal had been green for its direction. Driver 2 was operating an SUV eastbound and stated that the signal had changed before entering the intersection. The front passenger side of the SUV struck the driver side of the sedan. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was evaluated at the scene; the knee was swollen but the patient could bear weight with assistance. Passenger, seated in the rear of the SUV, reported no injuries. Both vehicles sustained heavy damage and were towed from the scene. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Both drivers were cooperative. Witness statements were collected and the signal timing log has been requested for further review.
